bloompets.party.modded: %s is always with you: companions need no place in your party
bloompets.party.wait: You can change your party again in %s
bloompets.call.lost: %s didn't come: it isn't where it was last seen
bloompets.storage.title: %s's storage
bloompets.command.none: You have no pets yet. Sneak and right-click a wild animal with its favourite food (/bloompets species) to bond with it.
bloompets.command.nospecies: No such pet in the roster (/bloompets species)
bloompets.screen.title: Pets
bloompets.screen.call.tip: Bring %s to you, wherever it is
bloompets.screen.party.tip: One Bloom pet at a time: it follows you and has its bonuses. Joining fills its health; the party can change every 5 minutes.
bloompets.screen.view.pet: Showing its pet traits (click for its Bloom weapon tree)
bloompets.screen.view.bloom: Showing its Bloom weapon tree (click for its pet traits)
bloompets.screen.slot.pet: Pet traits and skills come with pet levels
bloompets.screen.slot.bloom: Its weapon tree: pick one on the left; its effects open with its level
bloompets.guardian: %s stepped in and saved you! (Guardian Intervention: once a day)
bloompets.screen.slot.passive: Non-combat pets have no skill tree: their bonus for you is in the first slot
bloompets.screen.slot.modded: A companion's Spirit (the kind it fights like) and its skills come in a later update
bloompets.skill.awareness.desc: Steps out of fire, lava and cacti, back to your side. No fall damage.
bloompets.skill.gore.desc: A %s%% chance a hit does double damage (half its level in %%, up to 50%% at 100).
bloompets.skill.fast_food.desc: A 50%% chance to heal by the damage it deals.
bloompets.skill.thick_fur.desc: Takes half damage from attacks and arrows, and shakes off burning.
bloompets.skill.holy_hound.desc: Magic, poison and wither heal it instead of hurting it.
bloompets.skill.shock_proof.desc: Takes a sixth of the damage from explosions and lightning.
bloompets.skill.max.desc: A gold name and a sparkle. Once each time it comes out (called, or joining your party), a blow that would make it faint gives it a second wind instead: back to half health.
bloompets.skill.wolf.first.desc: When you and it hit the same enemy within 3 seconds, its bite deals 20%% more.
bloompets.skill.wolf.awareness.desc: It smells danger: steps out of fire, lava and cacti back to you, and lands soft (no fall damage).
bloompets.skill.wolf.gore.desc: A %s%% chance its bite tears deep: double damage, and the target Bleeds (half its level in %%, up to 50%% at 100).
bloompets.skill.wolf.special.desc: In a fight, every 30 seconds it howls: you and your pets nearby get Strength I for 6 seconds, and enemies near it are slowed.
bloompets.skill.wolf.fast_food.desc: A 50%% chance its bites mend it by the damage they deal.
bloompets.skill.wolf.thick_fur.desc: Half damage from blows and arrows; fire goes out on it fast.
bloompets.skill.wolf.holy_hound.desc: Poison, wither and magic mend it instead of hurting it.
bloompets.skill.wolf.shock_proof.desc: Explosions and lightning barely scratch it (a sixth of the damage).
bloompets.skill.iron_golem.first.desc: A walking fortress: +%s health while it's in your party (half a point a level).
bloompets.skill.iron_golem.special.desc: Once a day, while it follows you, a blow that would kill you leaves you at half a heart with Resistance II for 20 seconds. A totem in your hand goes first.
bloompets.skill.iron_golem.thick_fur.des: Takes half damage from attacks, arrows and fire, and shakes off burning.
bloompets.skill.polar_bear.first.desc: Can't be knocked back, slowed or frozen.
bloompets.skill.polar_bear.special.desc: Its hits slow (%s) and weaken (%s) for 5 seconds (Slowness IV and Weakness II from level 50).
bloompets.skill.goat.special.desc: Its third hit also launches the target high into the air.
bloompets.skill.panda.first.desc: When it wins a fight, it and you get Regeneration I for 8 seconds.
bloompets.skill.panda.special.desc: A %s%% chance on each hit to heal it, you and friends within 6 blocks for %s health, and hurt the undead nearby.
bloompets.mood.sad: %s is feeling down. It sulks until it cheers up: no skills, bonus or storage. Feed it, pat it (sneak + right-click with an empty hand), or let it rest at home.
bloompets.mood.tired: %s is getting tired. Let it rest at home (out of your party) for a few minutes, or it'll get grumpy fast.
bloompets.mood.hungry: %s is hungry: feed it its favourite food (sneak + right-click), or put some in its storage.
bloompets.mood.loved: %s loves you! ♥ It stays happy much longer for a while.
bloompets.storage.sad: %s is sulking and won't carry things right now (what it has is safe)
bloompets.screen.mood.sulking: Sulking: no skills, bonus, job or storage until it cheers up
bloompets.screen.mood.tired: Tired: let it rest at home (out of your party) for a few minutes
bloompets.screen.mood.how: Pat it (sneak + right-click with an empty hand) or feed it to cheer it up
bloompets.screen.hunger.how: Feed it its favourite food (sneak + right-click), or leave some in its storage: it eats by itself
bloompets.screen.bonus.near: While it's in your party, or while you're within 32 blocks of it (up to 3 nearby, one of each kind)
bloompets.bonus.polar_bear: You can't freeze, and Slowness can't touch you
bloompets.bonus.panda: Stand still a moment and you slowly heal
bloompets.bonus.llama: Spits at mobs that hit you (%s damage)
bloompets.bonus.camel: Speed on sand, soul sand and snow (Speed II from level 80)
bloompets.bonus.sniffer: Now and then it digs up a find near you (seeds, flowers, and rarely an armor trim); dirt you dig turns up seeds and flowers too
bloompets.bonus.fox: Mobs notice you from %s%% shorter range
bloompets.bonus.ocelot: Creepers and phantoms leave you alone, and you often wake up to a gift
bloompets.bonus.cat: Creepers and phantoms leave you alone, and you often wake up to a gift
bloompets.bonus.bee: Crops and saplings around you grow fast: Growth Aura with no hoe, %s%% stronger (owning the Major too is no faster)
bloompets.bonus.allay: Pulls nearby drops to you, and bottles loose XP into its storage
bloompets.bonus.cow: Clears one bad effect, then again after %s seconds
bloompets.bonus.pig: Lumberjack: fells whole trees with an axe, like Timber (owning the Major too is no faster)
bloompets.bonus.axolotl: You slowly heal while hurt, faster in water
bloompets.post.taken: %s will %s. Call it (or press Unpost) to bring it back.
bloompets.post.job.tend: tend the crops and saplings around here
bloompets.post.job.collect: collect the drops and loose XP around here
bloompets.post.job.watch: keep creepers and phantoms away from here
bloompets.post.job.spit: spit at monsters that come close
bloompets.post.away: %s isn't loaded: call it first, then leave it where it should work
bloompets.post.party: %s is in your party: take it out first
bloompets.post.level: %s can keep a post from level %s (it's level %s)
bloompets.post.full: You already have %s pets at posts: call one back first
bloompets.post.modded: %s keeps its own mod's ways (no posts for companions)
bloompets.screen.post.tip: Leave it here to work: guards guard, the Bee tends crops, the Allay collects drops, the Sniffer digs, the Llama spits, the Cat keeps creepers away (from level 8; 3 posts at most)
bloompets.screen.unpost.tip: Call it off its post (it stays where it is)
bloompets.screen.post.party: Take it out of your party first
bloompets.screen.post.modded: Companions keep their own mods' ways
bloompets.tree.needs: You need One and the Same (a Combat Major in Bloom) to give your pets a weapon tree
bloompets.tree.combat: %s isn't a combat pet: only combat pets and companions follow a weapon tree
bloompets.tree.already: %s already follows a tree: reset it first
bloompets.tree.wait: %s can pick a tree again in %s
bloompets.tree.reset: %s's tree is reset: it's back to level 1
bloompets.tree.reset.companion: %s's tree is reset: it can pick again in 5 hours
bloompets.effect.slash.desc: Half its hits make the target Bleed.
bloompets.effect.full_sweep.desc: Its hits sweep the enemies around its target (1 more than the hit's damage).
bloompets.effect.execute.desc: 30% more damage to a boss under half health, and to anything else under 70%.
bloompets.effect.aura_sword.desc: Every 5th hit, a sweep rolls out around it, 4 blocks.
bloompets.effect.armor_break.desc: Each hit wears the target's armor (half the damage, as durability).
bloompets.effect.guaranteed_critical.des: Every hit is a critical hit: 35% harder.
bloompets.effect.charge_attack.desc: Every 25 seconds its next hit does double damage (it sparks while it's ready).
bloompets.effect.leap.desc: Every 25 seconds in a fight it leaps onto its target, 4 to 12 blocks away; the hit it lands then is 50% harder.
bloompets.effect.lightning_shock.desc: Once every 2 seconds, a hit sends sparks to up to 3 enemies within 6 blocks (half the hit each).
bloompets.effect.predator.desc: Each hit in a row on the same target: +10%, up to +50%. Another target, or 5 seconds off it, starts over.
bloompets.effect.lightning_summon.desc: Every 25 seconds in a fight, lightning strikes its target: 6 damage and fire (never you, your pets or your house).
bloompets.effect.overkill.desc: 60% of a killing blow's extra damage splashes onto up to 3 enemies within 4 blocks.
bloompets.effect.combo.desc: Each hit in a row adds 0.25 damage, up to +5. 3 seconds without a hit starts over.
bloompets.effect.bloodlust.desc: Each kill: +8% damage for 10 seconds, up to 5 stacks.
bloompets.effect.disarm.desc: 30% of its hits knock the item out of a mob's hand.
bloompets.screen.tree.none: Only combat pets and companions follow a weapon tree
bloompets.screen.tree.title: %s tree
bloompets.screen.tree.pick: Click to choose. It stays: a reset puts the pet back to level 1
bloompets.screen.tree.pick.companion: Click to choose. It stays: after a reset it waits 5 hours to pick again
bloompets.screen.ability.on: On: click to switch it off
bloompets.screen.ability.off: Off: click to switch it on
bloompets.screen.tree.resting: Resting while it's out of your party (a tree works in the party or at a post)
bloompets.screen.tree.how: Its tree's effects work beside its own skills, opening at levels 10, 25, 50 and 75
bloompets.screen.tree.reset.companion: It can't pick a tree again for 5 hours
bloompets.screen.tree.confirm: Give %s the %s tree? It stays until you reset it.
bloompets.screen.tree.confirm.reset: Reset %s's tree? It goes back to level 1.
bloompets.screen.tree.confirm.reset.comp: Reset %s's tree? It can't pick one again for 5 hours.
